purpose: Test whether candidate-level parliamentary continuity has measurable territorial predictive value when estimated on a larger, standardized head-of-list panel rather than PJD alone.
why_only_these_parties: Both have standardized pre-election head-of-list rosters in 2016 and certified explicit head-of-list records in 2021. Other parties are not added until an equivalent head-of-list identity standard is demonstrated.

roster_sources.2016_RNI: morocco26-agent-society-v2:morocco26/data/goal100/agent_society_v2/acquisition/2016_candidate_party_augmented_wave2.json; accept only RNI rows from the national 4 September head-list publication source

features.definition: Head of list was elected in the immediately prior House cycle under the same party in the same certified local constituency.
Head of list was elected in the immediately prior House cycle under the same party but not in the same local constituency, including a prior national-list seat.
Head of list was elected in the immediately prior House cycle under another party.

identity_resolution.2016: Arabic candidate name against the complete 395-member 2011-2016 House universe, with audited normalization; collisions remain UNKNOWN unless party/territory context resolves uniquely.
identity_resolution.2021: Latin candidate name against the complete 395-member 2016-2021 House universe, using exact normalized identity first. Existing certified prior-member linkage may corroborate; unresolved high-similarity names remain UNKNOWN.

predictive_model.eligible_features: Only features passing the frozen support gate in both transitions.
predictive_model.target: Focal-party territorial vote-share residual versus C0 on the logit scale.
predictive_model.national_swing_control: Within the 2016 fit transition, subtract the party-specific mean target residual before fitting; no party intercept is carried into validation.
predictive_model.feature_centering: Center each feature using its 2016 party-specific mean; reuse those frozen party-specific means in 2021.
predictive_model.selection: Leave-one-region-out cross-validation on 2011_TO_2016 only; lowest held-out focal-party share RMSE, ties stronger regularization.
predictive_model.validation: Apply selected features, coefficients and alpha unchanged to 2016_TO_2021.

metrics.primary: pooled focal-party RMSE across all known PJD/RNI head cells
metrics.bootstrap: paired bootstrap over party-territory head cells, 10000 replicates, seed 260818

interpretation.material_signal: pooled relative RMSE improvement >= 0.5% and bootstrap P(model better) >= 0.90, with favorable sign for both PJD and RNI separately
interpretation.weak_signal: pooled improvement positive but material_signal fails
interpretation.no_signal: pooled validation RMSE is not improved

forbidden: Use 2021 outcomes for identity matching, feature selection, support thresholds, alpha, signs or coefficients
Treat a generic candidate as a head of list
Add PAM/PI after seeing 2021 performance inside this experiment
Invoke an LLM from this experiment before deterministic scoring is complete
